description: Safe medical reference knowledge for general education, triage boundaries, documentation, and health-information workflows. This is not diagnosis or treatment.

sections.name: Medical Safety Boundaries
sections.explanation_simple: Medical information can support understanding, organization, and preparation for a clinician conversation. It must not replace diagnosis, prescriptions, emergency judgment, or personalized treatment.
key_concepts: General information: educational explanation, not a diagnosis
Emergency symptoms: chest pain, severe breathing trouble, stroke signs, severe bleeding, or loss of consciousness require urgent care
Medication safety: dosing and interactions require licensed professional verification
Clinical context: age, history, exam findings, and labs change interpretation
Escalation: uncertain or high-risk symptoms should be referred to a clinician
sections.learning_path: General explanation -> red flag screening -> organize questions -> clinician referral

sections.name: Health Data Organization
sections.explanation_simple: Health workflows are safer when symptoms, timing, medications, allergies, reports, and questions are organized clearly before a medical appointment.
key_concepts: Symptom timeline: when symptoms started and how they changed
Medication list: name, dose, frequency, and start date
Allergies: drug, food, and material reactions
Vitals and labs: measured data with dates and units
Questions for clinician: concise list of concerns and decisions needed

topics.name: Medical capability note
topics.content: Tom can summarize general medical information and organize health data. It must not diagnose, prescribe, or replace urgent medical care.
